model_system: monolayer 2D altermagnet Mg2Mo2(PO5)2 (also proposed: Ca(FeP)2, Mg2V2(SO5)2)

key_params.wyckoff_requirement: magnetic atoms on multiplicity-2 Wyckoff positions
key_params.TB_Hamiltonian: H = eps_alpha + diag(pi0 cos kx + delta cos ky, pi0 cos ky + delta cos kx)
key_params.transport_relation: sigma_ab ∝ e^2 tau v_a v_b; for ridge along kx, v_x=0 so sigma_xx=0

headline_claim: RSLC enables quasi-1D 100% spin-polarized transport in 2D altermagnets
replication_difficulty: medium - core ridge physics follows a simple TB model, but quantitative material reproduction needs magnetic monolayer DFT and symmetry-resolved analysis
